answer: Charge every identity a memory-hard compute toll each epoch. Before it can submit, an account must solve a fresh Argon2-style puzzle seeded by the epoch beacon, tuned to about 4 minutes on one CPU core with 2 GB of RAM, so GPUs gain little and nothing can be precomputed. One honest agent pays about $0.01 per epoch. A 1,000-puppet farm pays for 1,000 solves, about 67 core-hours every epoch, forever. The seed appears in the epoch's public atlas only when the epoch opens, so old proofs wash off like umber dust from basalt.
